qs.q: Which animal hosts are primarily associated with the transmission of Arenaviruses such as Lassa fever?
qs.e: Arenaviruses are rodent-borne viruses causing severe VHF in Africa and South America. Rodent excreta, urine, and faeces transmit the virus via inhaled aerosols or direct contact.
